item.stem:
Kavya looks at the diagram of Shape $P$ and Shape $Q$. Both are built from the same $8$ unit squares, side-aligned with no gaps. Shape $P$ is a $2$-by-$4$ rectangle. Shape $Q$ is an L-shape made by moving squares.

Which claim correctly compares area and perimeter?

options.A: Area and perimeter both stay the same for every rearrangement of the $8$ squares.
options.B: Changing the arrangement creates the $8$ unit squares.
options.C: Area stays the same because both shapes use $8$ unit squares, but the perimeter can change.
options.D: Only Shape $P$ has an area, because it is a rectangle.
